# Third-party input files

The thirteen original files in 2023_JPP_iat come from gkeyllorg/gkyl-paper-inp at commit 7209ddbfe432b1826df3aa1f7f9fa7f32053a3af. They retain copyright 2012-2020 Ammar Hakim and the Gkeyll Team and the exact upstream MIT notice in UPSTREAM-LICENSE-MIT.txt. They are not authored by Taylor Kalin.

The historical Gkeyll solver source has different research-use terms and is not included here. Source PDFs, full author TeX and original raw simulation outputs are also excluded. Our metadata and own source-inspection notes do not relicense third-party work.
